## Stages

- [ ] Stage 1: Filing-index table
      Objective: Build one filing-index table from real SEC quarterly and daily index files.
      Outcomes: O1
      Consumes: the uv workspace scaffold
      Produces: the filing-index table, at a location the findings file names; specs/sec-filing-ingestion-stage-1-findings.md
      Exit: a filing-index table built from real quarterly and daily index files can be queried by CIK, form type and filing date; the findings file records the files fetched, the row count, the elapsed time and the request rate of the real run
      Leaves out: manifests and traceability (Stage 4); point-in-time awareness (Stage 5); full validation suite (Stage 6); scheduling and deployment, including a shared SEC request budget across concurrent runs (Stage 7)
      ROUTING: brainstorming

- [ ] Stage 2: Submission download
      Objective: Download the submissions that the filing-index table's rows name.
      Outcomes: O2
      Consumes: the Stage 1 filing-index table
      Produces: the submissions on disk, keyed to their index rows; a list of rows whose submission was not fetched
      Exit: every submission named by the rows in the stage's chosen range is on disk, or listed as not fetched with its reason
      Leaves out: manifests and traceability (Stage 4); point-in-time awareness (Stage 5); full validation suite (Stage 6); scheduling and deployment, including a shared SEC request budget across concurrent runs (Stage 7)
      ROUTING: brainstorming

- [ ] Stage 3: 10-K and 8-K handling
      Objective: Pick 10-K and 8-K filings out of the downloaded submissions and extract their main documents.
      Outcomes: O3
      Consumes: the Stage 2 submissions on disk and their index rows
      Produces: the extracted 10-K and 8-K main documents, each linked to its index row
      Exit: for the downloaded range, each 10-K and 8-K submission has its main document extracted, or is listed with the reason it was not
      Leaves out: manifests and traceability (Stage 4); point-in-time awareness (Stage 5); full validation suite (Stage 6); scheduling and deployment, including a shared SEC request budget across concurrent runs (Stage 7)
      ROUTING: brainstorming

- [ ] Stage 4: Manifests and traceability
      Objective: Make every index row, submission and extracted document traceable to its source bytes and rebuildable from them.
      Outcomes: O1, O2, O3
      Consumes: the outputs of Stages 1–3
      Produces: a manifest recording, for each output, its source URL, content hash and the code version that produced it; stored source bytes
      Exit: any index row, submission or extracted document reads back its source URL, hash and producing version; a rebuild from stored bytes with SEC access off gives the same output
      Leaves out: point-in-time awareness (Stage 5); full validation suite (Stage 6); scheduling and deployment (Stage 7)
      ROUTING: brainstorming

- [ ] Stage 5: Point-in-time awareness
      Objective: Absorb later SEC corrections to quarterly indexes without losing what the table showed before.
      Outcomes: O1
      Consumes: the Stage 4 manifest and stored source bytes
      Produces: a filing-index table that records additions, changed fields and withdrawals per re-read, and can be read as of an earlier date
      Exit: re-reading a changed quarterly index records its additions, changed fields and withdrawals; the table as it stood before that re-read still reads back unchanged
      Leaves out: full validation suite (Stage 6); scheduling and deployment (Stage 7)
      ROUTING: brainstorming

- [ ] Stage 6: Full validation suite
      Objective: Cover the ingested formats and failure cases with committed fixtures that run without SEC access.
      Outcomes: O1, O2, O3
      Consumes: the outputs of Stages 1–5
      Produces: a fixture-based test suite run in CI
      Exit: CI passes a suite covering the index formats in the ingested range, malformed and HTML responses, submission download failures, 10-K/8-K extraction and corrections, making no SEC requests
      Leaves out: scheduling and deployment (Stage 7)
      ROUTING: brainstorming

- [ ] Stage 7: Scheduling and deployment
      Objective: Run daily ingestion and the downstream steps on a schedule in a deployed environment.
      Outcomes: O1, O2, O3
      Consumes: the outputs of Stages 1–6
      Produces: a deployed, scheduled pipeline whose SEC requests share one rate budget
      Exit: two consecutive scheduled runs are recorded, each ingesting new daily index files and their submissions and 10-K/8-K documents, with all SEC requests under one shared rate budget
      Leaves out: nothing
      ROUTING: brainstorming
